cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need room for smaller ambitions. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. Withdrawing my best work gives them space to recover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'm conceding the pavement too. No need to overshadow their entrance.

mechanism: A presents gallery rejection and removal of paintings as strategic generosity while accommodating B collection logistics so the confident withdrawal story can continue.
confusable: Unlike simple optimism after rejection, A claims deliberate concessions from superior standing; borrowed confidence relies on B helping retrieve the work.
comparison: Creative rejection and physical collection differ from an elected successor taking actual controls.
seedUse: Use D65-b rejection/collection/outside/van and S02-b adapting the helper role to keep them cooperating.
